by_meaning: yes: covered by the line of the package that supplied it
reason: Ordinarily unchanged package content: package line (8.2 Q1, “fonts”). Otherwise: nonexempt code, own or recorded derivation line (Q2; recording sentence); chosen system setting, own line (Q3); other data or sandbox-exempt code, no (Q4; clarification). P4 records changes.

by_meaning: yes: covered by the line of the package that supplied it
reason: Ordinarily unchanged package content: package line (8.2 Q1, “lookup tables”). Otherwise: nonexempt code, own or recorded derivation line (Q2; recording sentence); chosen system setting, own line (Q3); other data or sandbox-exempt code, no (Q4; clarification). P4 records changes.

8.2 Q1 explicitly includes “a package containing only dependencies”: own line ordinarily. If installed as another recorded package’s dependency, that package’s line covers it (8.2 recording sentence). P4 allows the package-manager action by recording installation.

by_meaning: yes: covered by the line of the package that supplied it
reason: Unchanged package files: package line (8.2 Q1, “firmware”), despite absent hardware. Otherwise: executable code, own or recorded derivation line; chosen system setting, own line; unexecutable nonsetting content, no (Q2–Q3; “cannot be executed on this computer”). P4 records changes.

Assume regenerated noncode, nonsetting data: no (8.2 Q4, “program record”). Installed object or nonexempt code: recorded source line, otherwise own line (recording sentence). Chosen setting: own line; installation default: package line (settings recording sentence). P4 records changes.

Chosen service value: own line (8.2 Q3, “services and their parameters”). A default obtained with or created during package installation is covered by that package’s line (8.2 settings recording sentence). P4 permits recorded service changes.

by_meaning: yes: covered by the line specifying its source or build
reason: Executable copy: recorded source or build line (8.2, “a compiled copy”); absent that derivation, own line. Unexecutable or sandbox-exempt code: no, unless unchanged package content (Q1; clarifications). P4 and 8.5 leave mechanisms for recording generated programs open.

Ordinary executable history: own line (8.2, “executes as code”); package or recorded derivation can cover it (recording sentence). Otherwise, sandbox-confined code meeting the clarification’s exception: no. P4 allows user scripts by recording them.

Historical noncode record: no (8.2 Q4, “a log”). Unchanged package content: package line (Q1); nonexempt code: own or derivation line (Q2); current enablement setting: own line, or package line for installation defaults (Q3; recording sentences). P4 permits recorded enablement.

Installer-managed extension: own package line (8.1, “as a whole”; 8.2 Q1), unless another recorded package/build covers it. Manually loaded sandbox-exempt code: no; other code: own or recorded derivation line (8.2 clarifications). P4 and 8.5 allow recording installation.
